_help: Add one entry per file. Put the PDF in public/documents/ and reference it as /documents/<file>. category is one of: annualReport, financial, governance, other. Example (remove the underscore to activate): { "title": { "ja": "2025年度 事業報告書", "en": "2025 Annual Report", "fr": "Rapport annuel 2025" }, "date": "2026-06-30", "file": "/documents/2025-annual-report.pdf", "category": "annualReport" }
